sourceHashMethod: sha256 of JSON.stringify(Object.fromEntries(contentHashFields in declared order)); transcriptHash is sha256 of exact UTF-8 transcript; audioHash is sha256 of MP3 bytes.
reviewScope: Codex author self-review of all 240 source questions and seven chart prompts; not an independent human or psychometric review. 70 lexical application items reviewed as original sentence tasks. Human-source printed text/local ASR comparison and rights evidence have a separate report.
limits: Focused assessments are not complete IELTS papers or official score calibration.
Four locale labels describe synthetic TTS voices. Human variety labels follow explicit reader/source statements, not an acoustic certification.
An offline local catalogue avoids previewing answers; client-side files are not a secure exam vault.
